rule: Counts and dates only; every tile names its source. A bench's asOf is the sync time while its source is inside sourceWindow, and the source's own age when it is not, so the page never says fresh over old data. Never write actions, never approve, never delete. Finance and revenue are Tally's: Q never writes a money figure there.
refresh: npm run office-prep -- run <dump> <versions> <dest> (the hourly ticket runner). The dump must include `benches` (Command Center) and `jobs` (Team Hub) or the bench writes are dropped. Code: workshop/core/benches.ts (pure), workshop/office/benches.ts (reads the sources), tests beside each.

benches.source: Team Hub jobs collection (https://claude.ai/artifact/7kccfScydYDcWoXfeeE8q6), read each run; lead stages from projects/leads/index.json (the rows behind the Lead Log)
benches.window: 2 h (jobs are read live each run)
benches.compute: active / on-hold / filled / killed JOs by status; new = opened in the last 7 days; no owner = active with an empty team; depth seat = active with depth[]; lead sheets landed / phones added = stage dates present in the index

benches.source: One read-only Crelate pull per run (workshop/workforce/cli.ts, the Round Table board). Falls back to projects/workforce/board/current.json (Dean's Friday pull) when there is no key or no network, and then shows that file's age
benches.compute: team totals this week: RPs against goal and against the 15-a-day standard to date (Mon to Fri, recruiters in goal), PTCs, submittals, FTIs
benches.never: names beside numbers, pay, revenue per person

benches.source: Crelate roster from the same board pull (people with status 'starts'); 30-day plan files under projects/workforce/ (*prestart*.md, new-hires/*.md)
benches.sourceWindow: 7 d (plan files change only when a hire is added; the roster tiles are live)
benches.compute: new hires not yet started, next start date, 30-day plans open

benches.source: projects/workforce/eden-university/ files; the standing Wednesday Headhunter Training
benches.compute: dated training sessions on file, modules written (.md, not emails), tracks live (0 until the 90-day track is written), next Wednesday

benches.sourceWindow: 24 h (shows the schedule file's own age until Pam records status)
benches.compute: milestones due this week / slipped / done (done = every deliverable on it is Done); deliverables open / slipped / done
